{{< include /knowledge/includes/setup-parameters.qmd >}}

Is your civilization spending more on explosions than on figuring out why its own citizens stop working? Are your elected representatives being purchased by the industries they regulate? Has your species developed nuclear weapons, antibiotics, and the internet, and then pointed two of those three at each other?

You may be eligible for optimization.

Universe Optimization Services has been upgrading civilizations since before your sun ignited. Over 300 planets optimized. 100% satisfaction rate among clients who got started. (Clients who did not get started are not available for comment, as they are not available for anything. Some are available for mining rights. Contact us for details.)

Earth Optimization Services is our regional branch for your planet, one of several thousand subsidiaries Universe Optimization Services operates across the galaxy. Same parent company. Same proven technology. Smaller market. More shouting.

It brings the standard package to your small blue planet, including a dramatic reduction in the number of times your civilization can end itself. Currently: {{< var nuclear_winter_overkill_factor_nounit >}}. Recommended: No more than one as the other endings are mainly decorative.

## What It Does For You

For the average human, in order of what matters. All figures are modeled projections.

- **The disease coming for someone you love almost certainly has no cure yet. This is how one gets found.** {{< var global_annual_deaths_curable_diseases_nounit >}} people a year die of disease and aging, and for most of them no treatment exists, because the trial that would have found it was never funded; the money turned into a missile instead. The accelerated trials run the search, and the few cures already proven safe stop sitting in a drawer for {{< var efficacy_lag_years >}} and reach patients almost at once.
- **If you get sick, someone will actually be testing a fix.** Right now, for most diseases, no one is, and no one tells you that. Trial capacity goes from {{< var current_trial_slots_available >}} to {{< var dih_patients_fundable_annually >}} a year, so "nothing can be done" turns into "here, try this," and your disease is on the list.
- **You get the decades back, and they work.** Centuries of waiting fold down into one human life: the backlog of {{< var diseases_without_effective_treatment >}} with no treatment clears in {{< var dfda_queue_clearance_years >}} instead of {{< var status_quo_queue_clearance_years >}}, and aging itself slows in the first generation, then reverses in the next.
- **You get richer.** The Light package, the [1% Treaty](1-percent-treaty.qmd) [@1-percent-treaty-paper-2025] [@1-pct-treaty-impact-paper-2025] alone, adds about {{< var treaty_trajectory_lifetime_income_gain_per_capita >}} to the average person's lifetime income. Go Deluxe (full optimization) and it is {{< var wishonia_trajectory_lifetime_income_gain_per_capita >}}, because money spent on not-destruction turns out to produce things. Your economists will publish papers explaining why this was obvious in retrospect.
- **You stop paying to be able to murder everyone several times over.** Your species keeps enough firepower to end civilization {{< var nuclear_winter_overkill_factor_nounit >}} times: the world ends once, and you built the other {{< var nuclear_winter_spare_apocalypses_nounit >}} apocalypses for practice. The treaty trims the budget, not the deterrent: everyone cuts the same one percent at once, so nobody is easier to invade, and you keep every spare apocalypse you were never going to use. Humanity ran this exact move once, cutting military spending {{< var post_ww2_military_cut_pct >}} after the last world war, and walked into its largest boom.
- **It pays you to take it.** This is the only product that costs negative money, because you are buying assets rather than burning cash: the money is not new, it is what you already burn. Your share of starting the chain costs {{< var sharing_opportunity_cost >}} of your time. Everything above is what the time buys.
## What Comes in the Box

Every regional branch ships with four components. They are not metaphors. They are the parts of the machine.

**Earth Optimization Services** is the company. It buys influence over the companies that already influence government, then points that influence at policies that make the median human richer and less dead. This is considered ambitious because your current system points the influence at the people selling the influence.

**[Optimitron](optimocracy.qmd)** is the policy engine. It reads time-series data from thousands of jurisdictions and optimizes two numbers: median after-tax inflation-adjusted income and median health-adjusted life expectancy. The [Optimal Policy Generator](../appendix/optimal-policy-generator-spec.qmd) [@opg-paper-2025] asks which laws to enact, replace, repeal, or maintain. The [Optimal Budget Generator](../appendix/optimal-budget-generator-spec.qmd) [@obg-paper-2025] asks where the next public dollar stops buying much life or income and starts buying lobbyist furniture. Same appliance. Two knobs.

**[Wishocracy](wishocracy.qmd) [@wishocracy-paper-2025]** is how the humans say what they want without being handed a 4,000-line budget and a sedative. Each person answers small pairwise slider questions: "split $100 between clinical trials and missile defense." This captures intensity, not just yes/no grunting. RAPPA aggregates the comparisons into preference weights. Citizen Alignment Scores show which politicians did what the humans asked. [Incentive Alignment Bonds](incentive-alignment-bonds.qmd) [@iab-paper-2025] add consequences, a technology your political system has been avoiding.

**Wishonia Love** explains the machine. This is necessary because the machine's main proposal is "measure what works, fund what works, stop funding what kills you," and your species has made this sound complicated.

The investor model is short: money buys a return, not control. Earth Optimization Services buys influence over captured companies. Optimitron says which policies maximize median health and wealth. Wishocracy says what humans prefer under real tradeoffs. The lobbyists push the overlap. Everyone gets richer. Fewer people die.

This is not because humans became wise. It is because the machine stopped asking them to be.

## The Standard Package

Every civilization gets the same four products. We tried offering customization. It turns out every planet has the same four problems. They all think theirs are unique. They are not. The variables change. The dysfunction is identical.

### Product 1: The Evidence Engine

**What it does:** Counts which jurisdictions kept their citizens alive, and which buried them, then stops asking the ones who buried them for advice.

Your planet has 10,000 jurisdictions, each trying slightly different policies. Some of them produce healthy, wealthy, well-educated citizens. Others produce the opposite. Right now, you determine which is which by having politicians argue on television. The [Evidence Engine](optimocracy.qmd) replaces the arguing with counting.

The [Optimal Policy Generator](../appendix/optimal-policy-generator-spec.qmd) [@opg-paper-2025] examines what every jurisdiction tried and what happened next. It uses synthetic control, difference-in-differences, regression discontinuity, and Bradford Hill criteria so a pretty correlation cannot sneak into the cockpit wearing a fake mustache. The [Optimal Budget Generator](../appendix/optimal-budget-generator-spec.qmd) [@obg-paper-2025] calculates the optimal spending level for each public-good category, then ranks the gaps by marginal return and evidence quality. Both come standard.

No ideology required. No elections. No campaign contributions. Just the answer to the question "what actually worked?" applied to every decision your species currently makes by guessing.

Policy by regression discontinuity. The previous method was "whoever paid the most."

*"We spent 4,000 years debating education policy. The Evidence Engine resolved it in an afternoon. Our main regret is the 4,000 years." (Planet Keth-7, client since 8,000 BCE)*

### Product 2: The Budget Redirect

**What it does:** Finds the money.

Our flagship feature: knowing where the trillions went.

You do not need new money. You need to stop losing the money you have. You maintain {{< var global_warhead_count_nounit >}} nuclear warheads. You can only end your civilization once. The other {{< var nuclear_winter_overkill_factor_nounit >}} minus 1 endings are in storage, costing money, doing nothing. The [1% Treaty](1-percent-treaty.qmd) [@1-percent-treaty-paper-2025] [@1-pct-treaty-impact-paper-2025] moves 1% of every nation's military budget to clinical trials. Everyone reduces equally. Nobody is easier to invade. Everyone has {{< var dfda_trial_capacity_multiplier >}} more clinical trials. Disease eradication goes from {{< var status_quo_queue_clearance_years >}} to {{< var dfda_queue_clearance_years >}}.

Centuries of waiting, folded down into one human life. The diseases were never going to cure themselves; somebody just had to pay for the search instead of the warheads. That is the product.

*"We kept 11,000 warheads for 200 years after we only needed 50. Then we redirected 1% and cured our last disease in 22 years. The warheads did not notice they were missing." (The Yennari Collective, optimized 340 years ago)*

### Product 3: The Loving Takeover

**What it does:** Buys the opposition and makes it richer.

Congratulations on your purchase: the companies that own your government.

The companies that build your weapons also employ your best engineers and your most effective lobbyists. Destroying them would be wasteful. Fighting them would be expensive. [Buying them](../appendix/loving-takeover.qmd) is more fun.

You buy shares. Shares come with voting rights. Voting rights let you redirect lobbying budgets. The shareholders get a better long-term strategy. The employees get longer-lived (the treaty adds approximately {{< var avg_life_extension_per_beneficiary >}} to every beneficiary, including the people you just bought). The lobbyists get better clients. The engineers switch from guidance systems to surgical robots. Same math. Fewer craters.

Nobody loses anything. The CEO's mother gets her Parkinson's trial. The shareholders get appreciation. The lobbyists get a raise. The species gets to continue existing. We call this a Loving Takeover because, on most planets, the word for "everyone involved ends up better off" is just "love."

*"We were initially resistant. Then our chief weapons designer's daughter was cured of a disease he had been told was untreatable. He now runs our largest medical robotics division. He makes more money. He sleeps better. He no longer explains to strangers at parties what his company builds by changing the subject." (Military sector client, Spiral Arm 4)*

### Product 4: The Direct Allocation System

**What it does:** Lets the population spend its own money.

Your current system: you elect representatives. The representatives are purchased by industries. The industries write the laws. The laws benefit the industries. You pay for this. You call it "democracy." On my planet, we call it an odd thing to volunteer for.

[Wishocracy](wishocracy.qmd) [@wishocracy-paper-2025] replaces the middlemen with arithmetic. Citizens allocate resources directly through pairwise comparisons. Cancer research or missile contracts? Eighty percent of treaty funds go through the Wishocracy and cannot be touched by any individual. The other twenty percent goes through traditional channels and will be partially stolen. This is budgeted for. It is still cheaper than what you have now, where the percentage stolen is higher and also classified.

On *Who Wants to Be a Millionaire*, the studio audience picked the right answer {{< var crowd_decision_accuracy >}} of the time. The expert? {{< var expert_decision_accuracy >}}. Your entire government is phone-a-friend. We are offering you ask-the-audience.

*"Our representatives argued about healthcare allocation for 60 years. We switched to direct allocation. The citizens funded the same research the representatives had been blocking. The representatives became life coaches. The career transition was seamless." (Long-term client, Local Group)*

### Bonus Feature: Incentive Alignment

**What it does:** Moves the money so the lobbyist who used to sell missiles makes rent selling cures instead.

Every interest group on your planet currently profits from your dysfunction. Pharma profits from chronic treatment. Military industry profits from war. Politicians profit from the lobbyists who fund both. [Incentive Alignment Bonds](incentive-alignment-bonds.qmd) [@iab-paper-2025] rearrange the profit motive so that the most profitable thing anyone can do is [cure a disease](aligning-incentives.qmd).

Bondholders receive {{< var victory_bond_annual_return_pct >}} annually when the treaty passes. This is more than military lobbying currently pays. Lobbyists go where the money is. We moved the money.

*"We tried moral persuasion for 9,000 years. Then we tried paying them. Took six months." (Repeat client, 3 planets optimized, currently opening a 4th franchise)*

## How the Products Fit Together

The four products are one machine.

You buy the companies that currently control your government (Product 3). This gives you their lobbying apparatus, which is the most effective policy-change mechanism your species has ever built. You point it at the [Evidence Engine](optimocracy.qmd) (Product 1), which calculates the policies that maximize two numbers: median health-adjusted life expectancy and median after-tax inflation-adjusted income. The lobbyists push for those policies instead of the ones their previous owners wanted. The [1% Treaty](../solution/1-percent-treaty.qmd) (Product 2) funds it. The [Wishocracy](wishocracy.qmd) (Product 4) makes sure no one can redirect the lobbying back.

That is the entire service. Everything else is wiring you do not have to look at, the way you do not look inside the toilet tank that already knows when to stop.

Your current system uses the same components in the opposite order: companies buy the government, lobbyists push for policies that maximize shareholder profit, and nobody measures whether anyone got healthier or richer. Same machine. Same parts. Different direction.

## What You Get Back

Most products on your planet come with one benefit. A car moves you. A drug treats one disease, if one exists, which for most of them it does not yet. This one comes with a single downside and thirteen upsides, which is an unusual ratio, so we itemize it.

**The downside, in full.** If the campaign fails completely, you are left holding shares in the companies that currently run your government. They return roughly what military contractor stocks have always returned, and because we charge no carry and no management fee, you keep more of that than your neighbor keeps from the fund he is in. That is the floor. There is no version of this where the floor drops below "a slightly-better-than-average index fund." We have checked. Repeatedly. It is the least interesting part of the product, which is why we are moving on.

**The upside, which stacks.** If it works, your return does not arrive through one door. It arrives through thirteen at once, because curing disease and ending war happen to make almost everything else more valuable at the same time:

1. **Buying pressure.** Coordinated demand against a fixed supply of shares raises the price directly. [Mechanism](../appendix/loving-takeover.qmd).
2. **Credibility repricing.** As success becomes likely, the market prices it in. Buy before it does, and you keep the difference. [Terms](../economics/earth-optimization-fund.qmd).
3. **The pivot.** Comes in two trim levels. The *Deluxe package* (full [Wishonia optimization](../economics/gdp-trajectories.qmd)) makes the economy roughly {{< var wishonia_trajectory_gdp_vs_current_trajectory_multiplier_year_15 >}} larger by year 15; the *Light package* (the 1% Treaty alone) is already ~{{< var treaty_trajectory_gdp_vs_current_trajectory_multiplier_year_15 >}}. The companies you own capture that larger economy, and "not dying" is a larger market than "killing."
4. **Disease gets cheap.** The [dFDA](dfda.qmd) [@dfda-spec-paper-2025; @dfda-impact-paper-2025] makes cures faster and cheaper. A workforce that is alive and well produces and buys more. Every company you own is worth more in a world that is not sick.
5. **Bureaucracy gets cheap.** [Algorithmic administration](../appendix/algorithmic-public-administration-paper.qmd) replaces the agencies. The compliance overhead every company pays merely to exist falls.
6. **Your taxes fall, on everything.** The reclaimed waste lowers the tax on this investment and on every other thing you own, so your after-tax return rises across your entire portfolio, not just this slice. [The dysfunction tax](../appendix/political-dysfunction-tax.qmd).
7. **Regulation gets rational.** Policy chosen by what measurably works removes the regulatory drag companies currently price in as pure friction. (See "Why Your Government Does Not Have a Thermostat," below.)
8. **War gets rarer.** Less organized violence is a [peace dividend](../economics/peace-dividend.qmd): less destruction, more stability, lower risk on everything you hold.
9. **The lobbying comes back.** The companies stop spending billions on lobbying that loses money for their own shareholders. That line item returns to you. [Tier 1](../appendix/loving-takeover.qmd).
10. **The big number.** The [political dysfunction tax](../appendix/political-dysfunction-tax.qmd) [@political-dysfunction-tax-paper-2025], roughly {{< var political_dysfunction_global_opportunity_cost_total >}} a year of recoverable waste, stops being wasted. Some of it becomes your return.
11. **Your whole net worth rides along.** The one people miss: a larger economy lifts everything you own that tracks it, and some of the public-good leakage lands in the rest of your balance sheet. [The number you are actually betting](../economics/earth-optimization-fund.qmd).
12. **Your money stays usable.** Every extra healthy year is a year you can still spend what you saved. [Your money is worthless the day you die](../call-to-action/your-personal-benefits.qmd).
13. **Nobody skims it.** Money and influence are [disentangled](incentive-alignment-bonds.qmd): no one sits in the middle taking a cut, so more of every gain above reaches you instead of an intermediary.

One downside, capped at "ordinary." Thirteen upsides, compounding on each other and on the rest of your money. We did not engineer the lopsided odds on purpose. It is lopsided because the same act that ends war and disease also happens to make nearly everything else worth more.

And there is a fourteenth thing, which is not another channel but the reason the thirteen are not lumpy the way every other investment is. Your Warren Buffett beat your market two-to-one for sixty years and *still* rode a roller-coaster, because he was investing inside a system that periodically robs the table: money-printing booms, disorderly busts, malinvestment, regulatory whiplash, war. Every investor on your planet eats that volatility as if it were weather. It is not weather. It is policy, and policy is a choice. This is the only product on the shelf that proposes to fix the table itself. You are not merely buying a position. You are buying the repair of the casino your entire net worth is already sitting in.

For the exact terms, the launch sequence, the [return ladder, and why this is not Buffett](../economics/earth-optimization-fund.qmd), see the Earth Optimization Fund page, including a calculator that lets you set your own probabilities.

*"I came for the investment thesis. I stayed because my other, unrelated investments also rose, my taxes fell, and I stopped dying. The cross-selling on this product is extraordinary." (Diversified holder, Sector 12)*

## Why It Spreads

The Standard Package has two moving parts that most clients overlook until they see them working together.

The [Loving Takeover](../appendix/loving-takeover.qmd) is the capital mechanism. You buy shares, gain board control, redirect lobbying. This costs {{< var defense_takeover_cost_total >}}. If the thesis works, shareholders may benefit from better strategy and a larger economy. Capital in, more capital out.

The [Earth Optimization Prize](../strategy/earth-optimization-prize.qmd) [@earth-optimization-prize-paper-2025] is the distribution mechanism. You recruit voters for the [1% Treaty](../solution/1-percent-treaty.qmd), and for every verified human you bring in you earn Earth Optimization Points: a claim on the prize pool. Every new person makes the pool bigger, so the earlier you recruit, the more each point is finally worth. This is how something with almost no money today pays you out of the world it builds tomorrow. You do not need to understand the thesis. You need to want money. What you cannot do is buy or sell a vote: the vote is one per human, not for sale, not tradeable, and separate from the points entirely. We pay you to find the voters, not to be one. Money and influence sit at separate tables, which is the entire point of the building.

On most planets, these two mechanisms are separate programs run by separate departments that compete for the same budget. On your planet, we wired them together. This is the part that matters.

::: {.diagram}
```
EARTH OPTIMIZATION SERVICES

EOS, Inc. (Delaware C-corp) / sponsor
 |
 +-- EOS equity (the activist vehicle)
 |    +-- First: private holding company (Reg D 506(c), accredited investors)
 |    +-- Goal: public listing as fast as campaign results allow
 |    +-- Mission-lock (after first close): steward holds voting shares, bound to Wishocracy

```
:::

This is why EOS equity comes first. Normal humans can understand it: buy the companies that buy policy, then make the policy less stupid. The other machinery still matters. It just does not need to be printed on the cereal box.

The Takeover generates returns. The returns fund the Prize. The Prize pays people to recruit voters. The voters create awareness. The awareness attracts investors. The investors fund more Takeover. The Takeover generates more returns.

This is not a metaphor. It is a feedback loop with the same structure as compound interest, except the compounding variable is people instead of dollars.

In epidemiology, a system spreads if R > 1: each participant creates more than one new participant. Your species has two categories of people. The first category responds to logic (they read these arguments, check the math, and act). The second category responds to incentive (they do not read anything, but they will recruit voters if you pay them). Logic alone reaches category one. Incentive alone reaches category two. Together, they probably cover enough of the population to push R above 1. The math suggests this is sufficient, though your species has surprised us before, usually in the wrong direction.

This book (these arguments, these numbers) is the initial seed. The Prize is the transmission mechanism. The Takeover is the payload that restructures the host. Together, they make EOS something your species does not have a good word for: a self-replicating system where the capital mechanism feeds the distribution mechanism feeds the capital mechanism, and the cost of entry is {{< var sharing_opportunity_cost >}} of time.

Your charities ask for donations. Your funds ask for investments. This asks for neither. It asks you to tell two people, which costs nothing, and lets compound interest do the rest. The reason most movements on your planet stall is that spreading the message is a cost with no return. The Prize makes spreading the message the highest-returning activity available to anyone with a phone and {{< var sharing_opportunity_cost >}} to spare.

On 47 of the 50 planets where we have deployed this loop, it reached majority participation within one generation. The other three took two generations. None required three. Once R exceeds 1, the math is patient. It does not need to convince everyone. It needs to convince everyone that everyone else is being convinced, which, on your planet, is called a stock price going up.

## Why Your Government Does Not Have a Thermostat

Your oven has a sensor. It measures the temperature inside the oven, compares it to the temperature you requested, and adjusts the heating element until the two numbers match. This is called a closed-loop control system. Every appliance in your home has one. Your air conditioner, your cruise control, your refrigerator, your toilet. The toilet knows when to stop filling. Your government does not know when to stop filling.

```
YOUR OVEN (closed-loop):

  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
  │                                                  │
  │   Set 350°F ──► Heating ──► Oven ──► Food       │
  │       ▲         Element      │                   │
  │       │                      │                   │
  │       └──── Thermometer ◄────┘                   │
  │              (measures actual                     │
  │               temperature,                       │
  │               adjusts input)                     │
  │                                                  │
  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
  The oven CHECKS whether the food is the right
  temperature. If not, it ADJUSTS. This is why
  your food is edible.

YOUR GOVERNMENT (open-loop):

  ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
  │                                                  │
  │   "War on    ──► $1 Trillion ──► Drug ──► ???    │
  │    Drugs"         Spending        Policy         │
  │                                                  │
  │                                (no sensor)       │
  │                                (no measurement)  │
  │                                (no adjustment)   │
  │                                                  │
  │           Overdose deaths: 6,000 ──► 107,000     │
  │           Budget change:   none                  │
  │           Duration: 53 years and counting        │
  │                                                  │
  └─────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
  The government DOES NOT CHECK whether the policy
  is working. If overdoses increase 18x, it does
  not adjust. It increases the budget. This is why
  your citizens are dead.
```

In control systems engineering, this is called an open-loop system. You set an input and walk away. Whatever happens, happens. No measurement. No correction. No feedback. The technical term for operating a complex system this way is "stupid." I verified this with engineers on four planets. They all used the same word, though three of them said it more politely.

Your War on Terror: $8 trillion spent, terrorist attacks went from about 1,000 per year to nearly 17,000 per year. No sensor. No adjustment. Fifty-three years of drug war with 18x more overdoses. No sensor. No adjustment. You are operating the most complex system in your solar system (a civilization of {{< var global_population_2024_nounit >}} humans) with less feedback instrumentation than a toaster.

The Standard Package installs the thermostat.

The [Optimitron](optimocracy.qmd) is the sensor. It measures two numbers (median health-adjusted life expectancy and median after-tax inflation-adjusted income) across every jurisdiction on Earth and calculates which policies caused which outcomes. The [Loving Takeover](../appendix/loving-takeover.qmd) is the actuator (it controls the lobbying apparatus that controls Congress). The [1% Treaty](../solution/1-percent-treaty.qmd) is the power supply. The [Wishocracy](wishocracy.qmd) is the allocation circuit. And the feedback loop closes because the Optimitron measures the output of the policies it recommended, compares them to the target, and adjusts. Like a thermostat. Like a toilet. Like every system your species builds when it bothers to think about it for ten seconds.

Every component in this circuit has uncertainty. The sensor might be gamed (five independent data sources make this impractical; see the [capture resistance design](optimocracy.qmd)). The actuator might resist (the Loving Takeover aligns their financial interests). The power supply might be cut (the treaty is self-reinforcing; cutting it costs politicians their funding). The allocation circuit might be corrupted (80% flows through Wishocracy, which has no middlemen to bribe). Control systems engineering accounts for component uncertainty. Your species does this for airplane autopilots and chemical plants. We are applying it to civilization. The math is the same. The stakes are higher. The difficulty is lower, because civilizations are simpler than chemical plants. (Chemical plants do not vote against their own interests.)

*"We tried running our government without a feedback loop for 200 years. The engineers found this extremely funny. They kept asking 'but how do you know if it worked?' and we kept saying 'we argue about it.' They stopped laughing when they realized we were serious." -- Planet Keth-7*

## Premium Add-ons

The Standard Package handles the big four: evidence, funding, takeover, allocation. But most planets also want the government replacement suite. These are the modules that automate the functions your elected officials currently perform badly, expensively, and while being paid by the people they are supposed to regulate.

Each module replaces one government agency with software. The software does not accept campaign contributions. The software does not have a revolving door. The software does not need 80,000 employees to perform arithmetic.

### The Decentralized FDA

**Replaces:** Your drug approval agency, which currently blocks safe treatments for an average of 12 years after safety is established.

**With:** An [open protocol](dfda.qmd) that connects treatments to patients and records outcomes automatically. Drug inserts (the pamphlet nobody reads, written by the company selling the drug) are replaced with Outcome Labels: real-world data from millions of patients showing what actually happened. Trial costs drop from {{< var traditional_phase3_cost_per_patient >}} per patient to {{< var recovery_trial_cost_per_patient >}} per patient. The RECOVERY trial already proved this works.

*"Our FDA equivalent once took 14 years to approve a treatment that had been safely used on 2 million patients in neighboring jurisdictions. The [Decentralized FDA](dfda.qmd) [@dfda-spec-paper-2025; @dfda-impact-paper-2025] approved it in 4 months. The 14-year agency is now a museum. The museum is not well attended." (Client, Triangulum Galaxy)*

### Decentralized Institutes of Health

**Replaces:** Grant committees where researchers spend 40% of their time writing applications instead of doing research.

**With:** A [coalition for curing disease](dih.qmd) modeled on your military-industrial complex, except pointed at biology instead of geography. Treaty funds flow to researchers by whether the patient got better, not by whose grant prose was prettiest. Find something that works, you get paid. Find nothing, you do not. This is considered radical in your current system, where the check clears whether or not anyone left the hospital.

## Your Planet

Earth is classified as a Standard Optimization Case. Your problems are not unusual. Your technology is adequate. Your dysfunction is textbook. You score 94.7% similarity with [Moronia](../futures/moronia.qmd) on the Pre-Optimization Assessment, which is the highest similarity score we have ever recorded with a planet that went extinct. This is not a compliment.

The good news: every planet that scores above 90% similarity with Moronia and then optimizes shows an even larger post-optimization improvement than average. You are not unusually broken. You are unusually ready. The spring is compressed very far. The bounce will be proportionally dramatic.

Earth Optimization Services is the legal structure your system requires in order to begin. On most planets, you do not need to incorporate a company to stop people from dying. On yours, you do. So we did.

The people who operate it own no more of it than anyone else. On my planet, building something that belongs to everyone is just called building something. On yours it requires a securities filing and a conversation about incentive structures that I have [provided elsewhere](../economics/earth-optimization-fund.qmd) because it is long.

## How to Order

**Option 1: Free** (30 seconds)
[Vote](https://warondisease.org) and share the [20 Questions](../strategy/questions.qmd) with two people. If the average person shares with two people, this reaches half of humanity in 32 rounds. Your 30 seconds have never been this valuable.

**Option 2: Put your name on the EOS investor list**

The first money product is EOS equity: you buy non-voting shares of the holding company directly (Berkshire model, no separate fund). EOS uses the capital to buy activist positions in companies whose lobbying controls policy and to pay its operating costs. Do not send money yet. There is nowhere honest to put it. Put your name on the list so the first close knows how many term sheets are waiting.

**Option 3: Private now, public as fast as possible**

The private phase is the minimum necessary starting point. The goal is to go public through a direct listing, IPO, or whatever public-company path is least stupid once the HII campaign produces a verifiable result. Once public, anyone on Earth can buy in with $5. That is the distributed-ownership endgame in practical form. The [Earth Optimization Fund](../economics/earth-optimization-fund.qmd) page has the pricing formula and the calculator.

**Option 4: Side paths**

If you are impatient, the [Loving Takeover](../appendix/loving-takeover.qmd) and [a legal letter the board must read](../appendix/lawsuit.qmd) show the direct-shareholder route. That is for plaintiffs and volunteers. EOS equity is the thing normal investors can understand without developing a hobby in corporate procedure.

All four point at the same outcome. EOS equity is the money product on the sign.

The guarantee: full refund if the world ends more than once.
